notes.text: Fix dialog message when deleting multiple messages from a notification
Message view / list: fix NPE when list is empty
If there is no message when resuming, K-9 should return to a MessageList.

Add a caching layer to EmailProvider.  Database updates can be surprisingly slow. This lead to slow updates of the user interface which in turn made working with K-9 Mail not as fun as it should be. This commit hopefully changes that.
